selection.title: Batch targets
selection.what: Selects the saved circuits included in this batch preview.
selection.how: Review each selected circuit; saving a batch does not start acquisition.

signed.title: Allow negative increments
signed.what: Declares signed counter semantics for this saved measurement.
signed.how: Use only when the source permits negative increments. Signed counters cannot use the rollover policy.

modulus.title: Rollover modulus
modulus.what: The exact positive modulus used to interpret a counter wrap.
modulus.how: Optional positive decimal text, at most 64 characters. No exponent notation; signed or floating counters cannot use it.
modulus.example: 65536 only for a documented modulo-65536 counter.

rate.title: Maximum rate per second
rate.what: Bounds plausible counter growth when evaluating rollover.
rate.how: Optional positive decimal text, at most 64 characters, requiring a modulus. Do not infer it from a sample.
rate.example: 100 only when the source specification supports that limit.

mode.title: Switch direction
mode.what: Chooses a forward switch or rollback of an existing switch.
mode.how: Review source, destinations and boundary before applying; this can change which recording runs.

source.title: Source recording
source.what: The saved recording whose active sources will switch.
source.how: Only eligible saved records are offered; a name alone does not grant ownership.

target.title: Target recordings
target.what: The prepared saved destinations for the selected source scope.
target.how: Select eligible long-format targets and review the exact effect before applying.

rollback.title: Previous switch
rollback.what: Identifies the prior switch eligible for rollback.
rollback.how: Choose the exact recorded operation and review its boundary and started targets.
rollback.example: The operation at the intended recorded boundary.

boundary.title: Switch boundary
boundary.what: The requested local date and time for a reviewed switch.
boundary.how: The existing converter sends an instant; the server-reviewed boundary remains authoritative. Review before applying.
boundary.example: A future local time agreed for the switch.
